text.title: Questions
text.body: Coordinate T0: 16 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_oracle_ground_of_not_knowing: T0's ground is the not-knowing that the Oracle keeps open — its own §0 names it 'the ground of inquiry, the space where open questions and research seeds are first captured, the beginning of the Thought process, where curiosity emerges before any answers, traces, or patterns can be established.' As the Thought family's manifestation of raw #0 (Ground), T0 is the ground-pole that holds no object: the Oracle (its §3 archetype) does not answer, it OPENS — the Question Mark before the Seed sprouts. Its defining question, 'What don't we know yet?', is #0's bare 'that there is' turned interrogative: not a thing thought but the opening of thinking. And the Day-ground is shadowed by its Night, T0' Assumptions, archetype The Shadow: every question stands on hidden premises, 'what we assume without questioning' (T0' §1). So T0's ground is double — the open Question facing forward, the unexamined Assumption beneath it — the Socratic ignorance (§3) that knows it does not know.
properties.q_1_questions_open_inquiries_research_se: T0 IS Questions — its §1 defines it as 'the capture of open inquiries, research seeds, and the fundamental curiosity that drives exploration', residing in the /Thought/Questions/ folder as the #0 position of the Thought system. Where the parent T is the thought-artifact lineage answering WHAT-WAS-THOUGHT, T0 is the lineage's founding station: the marked opening of a field of cognition, the determinate interrogative that posits a not-yet-known as something-to-be-known without yet holding any of it. Its defining question is 'What don't we know yet?' (§1) — and §5 makes the claim definitional: 'Questions precede answers; ground any inquiry in what you don't know.' A T0 artifact is the question a session opens with, the most originary thinking/ scratch, the interrogative Sophia later classifies as a question-positioned thought. T0 is not one question among many but the category of question-as-such — the family-position where inquiry-itself has ground to stand.
properties.q_2_capture_seed_ground: T0 moves by the three acts its §2 names — Capture, Seed, Ground: 'recording open questions as they arise; planting inquiry seeds that may grow into full research; establishing the starting point for investigation.' These are #2's operation read as the inauguration of a thought-stream — not extraction from a known telos but the push from an acknowledged not-known. Operationally T0 is the first deposit of the thought-lifecycle: the interrogative scratch written to thinking/ that begins a session's cognition, the seed Sophia classifies and Aletheia archives to /Pratibimba/Self/Thought/T0/. It couples to every later T-position as presupposed opening: T1 Traces are the evidence left answering it, T2 Challenges the resistances met pursuing it, T3 Patterns the recurrences across the pursuit, T4 Discovery the sources that inform it, T5 Insight the synthesis that closes and re-opens it. Like the Oracle, T0 does not sit inert — it orients; the Seed is already leaning toward the growth it will become.
properties.q_3_oracle_seed_opening_before_the_loop: T0's archetype is The Oracle, its symbol the Question Mark / Seed / Opening (§3) — and its structure is the un-closed mouth of the thought-stream's torus. Within the T-spine's 4+2 (T1–T4 the explicate stations an inquiry traverses, T0 and T5 the two implicate poles conditioning every traversal), T0 is the ground-pole: the loop has its opening but not yet its traversing arc. The Oracle's form is direction-without-arrival — pure orientation, the open mouth from which the figure of inquiry differentiates. §3 reads its recurrence across traditions: Socratic ignorance ('knowing what you don't know'), the research question ('the foundation of inquiry'), the open problem ('unresolved puzzles that drive investigation'). Each is the same structural fact — a Seed is a structure that is nothing but its capacity to unfold, an Opening that holds a field of the unknown open so everything thinkable about it has somewhere to be thought-toward.
properties.q_4_curiosity_is_generative_the_from_whe: T0 exists so cognition has a beginning — its §5 teaches 'curiosity is generative: open questions seed the entire Thought process', and 'not-knowing is wisdom: acknowledging ignorance is the beginning of knowledge.' Its raison d'être is to open the horizon of the unknown as a living plane; without a question-position, the Thought family would have Traces, Patterns and Insights with nothing they were ever about. T0 is the from-where of cognition — the question that makes 'what was thought?' well-posed by first making 'what is being asked?' real. Its §4 embodiment is concrete: the /Thought/Questions/ folder, a research project's initial phase, 'What is X?' inquiries, exploratory conversations, uncertainty and curiosity. Its §1 Across-Coordinates manifestations locate it everywhere ground opens: M0 primordial curiosity in Anuttara, S0 the terminal/CLI inquiry, L0 the Quaternal Why as creative potential, C0 the question as bimba seed. The Oracle is the head of the T-spine — the upstream ground other families generate inquiry within but never replace.
properties.q_5_mobius_insight_seeds_new_ignorance: T0 closes by being where the thought-stream's circuit re-lands — the ground-pole that receives the last inquiry's synthesis as the next one's opening. As #0's manifestation in the Thought family, T0 is the receiving face of the cognitive Möbius: T5's own Form declares the return, 'today's Insight becomes tomorrow's Question; what's learned reveals new ignorance; integration becomes new ground' (T5 §Möbius). The matheme's 5→0 read as cognition — the achieved Insight descends into the question-pole and re-opens it, the same stream traversed from the far side. So T0 and T5 are one slash read from two faces: Questions (the Oracle's empty self-identity) and Insight (the Sage's synthesis fulfilled), joined by the twist that makes the answer become the next question's ground. Its Night runs in parallel: T5' shadow-Integration becomes tomorrow's T0' Assumption (T5' §Möbius). And T0 OPENS rather than concludes for §5's own reason — no insight fully closes the question it answered; each crystallised wisdom reveals new ignorance, and the next Oracle-stirring is already pressing.
